_about: Shared rules from the brand team (Threads Growth Experiment + hustle-threads-hypothesis skill). Used in every report and plan.

hypothesis_types.H1: Strong Expert POV - a clear claim that can differ from common opinion
hypothesis_types.H2: Pattern Recognition - she recognises her own behaviour or his
hypothesis_types.H3: Cost of Inaction - framed as permission to leave, never fear or guilt

content_principles: Conversion Intent (a clear reason to tap the link)
avoid: long discussions with no conversion intent
content unrelated to the product funnel
outlier_rule: engagement = likes + replies + reposts + shares; multiple = post / median of the author's last 40 posts; ✅ 5x or more, 🟡 3-5x, ❌ below; reposts are the main reach signal

pain_clusters.name: Waiting for his text, chasing him
pain_clusters.angle: her worth and his effort, not 'you're too needy'

pain_clusters.name: Missing an ex, no contact
pain_clusters.angle: not going back is strength, not defeat

pain_clusters.name: Wants to break up after every fight
pain_clusters.angle: 'this isn't drama' - protect her from the label

pain_clusters.name: Can't leave, keeps going back
pain_clusters.angle: describe the pattern without the word 'trauma bond'

pain_clusters.name: Settling for the bare minimum
phrases: always the one who tries harder
pain_clusters.angle: permission verdict: the minimum is the answer

pain_clusters.name: Childhood shapes who she picks
pain_clusters.angle: 'If you grew up...' form; no 'inner child' in the post

pain_clusters.name: He cheated, she stayed - glow-up
phrases: why did I stay so long
pain_clusters.angle: staying was the mistake, leaving is the win

pain_clusters.name: Faith and pain
pain_clusters.angle: God as protection and comfort, not 'prayer didn't work'
